design_analysis.layout: Parallel lanes expose identical selection logic and distinct source populations. Lateral exclusion branches conserve a clear retained-population path.
design_analysis.color: Green denotes retained/source flow; gray exclusion boxes supply both color and text distinction.
design_analysis.unit: Patients and images have explicitly different labels; the lower split is diagnostic category, not train/test allocation.

transferable_rules: Retain analysis-unit labels beside every count; images are nested observations and cannot be substituted for patients.
Audit arithmetic separately from scientific independence.
Represent external cohorts in a separate lane; add train/validation/test splits only from explicit source evidence.
If exclusion-reason subtotals are absent, do not manufacture them.
nontransferable_content: Cohort sizes, dates, criteria and split percentages do not transfer to another study.
Do not rename the pictured retrospective external cohort as prospective.
limitations_and_ambiguities: Methods describes lesion-level splits while flow uses patients; equal counts in tables do not establish that all patients had exactly one lesion.
No per-criterion exclusion counts or IDs supplied; arithmetic checks do not establish disjointness.
